_comment: Critical journey for the journey-app fixture (a tidal harbour's visitor-berth booking). The walkthrough evaluator walks these steps; the analytical CW ground truth is in ground-truth.json (defects with a cw field). Test values only: MMSI 123456789 has no valid country prefix and 07700 900123 is in Ofcom's drama range.
title: Book a visitor berth for a weekend

persona.group: Skippers of visiting cruising yachts who have not used this harbour before
knows: their boat's length overall, 10.4 metres including the bowsprit, and its hull length, 9.6 metres
their boat's MMSI, because the radio has digital selective calling
that tidal harbours can only be entered around high water
does_not_know: which pontoon is long enough for their boat
whether the harbour publishes tide times in local time or UTC
persona.context: On a phone in the cockpit the evening before, with patchy mobile data and one hand on the tiller line

goal: Have a safe place for the boat for two nights, arriving on the afternoon tide
scenario: You are sailing to the quay on Saturday 17 October 2026 and want to stay two nights. You expect to arrive around three in the afternoon. Your yacht is 10.4 metres long including the bowsprit and draws 1.5 metres. Make sure there is a place waiting for you.

start_state.data: all four visitor berths are free on 17 and 18 October 2026
